svg.title: Next: finish the lines and open the stations
svg.desc: Top-down cartoon map of the end-of-2026 target. Crab crews lay Rust track on the Messages, Responses and Chat completions lines. Cache, Vault, Post office and Ledger are new Rust buildings with Opening soon tape. A sign reads Target: end of 2026. The Gate and Router are still wooden, with a sign saying they come after the lines.
svg.text: Next: finish the lines and open the stations
The big three lines get Rust track, and every station on them opens as Rust.
